```{r}
# Step 1: Library
library(MASS)
library(dplyr)
library(quantmod)
library(rugarch)
library(copula)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(tidyr)
```
```{r}
# Step 2: Data Cleaning
options(repr.plot.width = 8, repr.plot.height = 5)
data <- read.csv('D:/statmethfindata.csv')

vars <- c("PlanName", "fy", "StateAbbrev",
          "ActFundedRatio_GASB", "ActLiabilities_GASB", "ActAssets_GASB",
          "EQTotal_Rtrn", "FITotal_Rtrn", "RETotal_Rtrn", "PETotal_Rtrn",
          "EQTotal_Actl", "FITotal_Actl", "RETotal_Actl", "PETotal_Actl",
          "contrib_tot", "expense_TotBenefits",
          "InvestmentReturnAssumption_GASB",
          "MktAssets_net")

df <- data[, vars]
df_clean <- df[!is.na(df$ActFundedRatio_GASB) & 
               !is.na(df$EQTotal_Rtrn) & 
               !is.na(df$FITotal_Rtrn), ]
```

```{r}
# Step 3: Initial Asset Allocation
assets_annual <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(fy) %>%
  summarise(A_total = sum(ActAssets_GASB, na.rm = TRUE))

# Initial assets for each test year XX = total assets at end of XX-1
A0_list <- list()

for (XX in 2017:2024) {
  A0 <- assets_annual %>% filter(fy == (XX - 1)) %>% pull(A_total)
  A0_list[[as.character(XX)]] <- A0
  cat("XX =", XX, " | Initial assets (XX-1):", format(A0, big.mark=","), "\n")
}

agg_df <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(fy) %>%
  summarise(A = sum(ActAssets_GASB, na.rm=TRUE),
            L = sum(ActLiabilities_GASB, na.rm=TRUE),
            FR = A/L)

ggplot(agg_df, aes(x=fy)) +
  geom_line(aes(y=A/1e9, color="Assets"), size=1) +
  geom_line(aes(y=L/1e9, color="Liabilities"), size=1) +
  labs(title="Aggregate Sponsor Assets vs Liabilities",
       y="$ Billions", x="Year") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Step 4: Asset Returns

# Get monthly returns
tickers <- c("SPY", "IEF", "VNQ", "PSP")
getSymbols(tickers, src="yahoo", from="2006-01-01", to="2024-12-31", periodicity="monthly")

spy_ret <- diff(log(Ad(SPY)))
ief_ret <- diff(log(Ad(IEF)))
vnq_ret <- diff(log(Ad(VNQ)))
psp_ret <- diff(log(Ad(PSP)))

returns <- na.omit(merge(spy_ret, ief_ret, vnq_ret, psp_ret))
colnames(returns) <- c("EQ", "FI", "RE", "PE")

cat("Total return observations:", nrow(returns), "\n")

# Price growth
prices <- na.omit(merge(Ad(SPY), Ad(IEF), Ad(VNQ), Ad(PSP)))
colnames(prices) <- c("SPY", "IEF", "VNQ", "PSP")

prices_df <- data.frame(
  date = index(prices),
  SPY = as.numeric(prices$SPY) / as.numeric(prices$SPY)[1] * 100,
  IEF = as.numeric(prices$IEF) / as.numeric(prices$IEF)[1] * 100,
  VNQ = as.numeric(prices$VNQ) / as.numeric(prices$VNQ)[1] * 100,
  PSP = as.numeric(prices$PSP) / as.numeric(prices$PSP)[1] * 100
)

prices_long <- melt(prices_df, id.vars="date", variable.name="Asset", value.name="Price")

ggplot(prices_long, aes(x=date, y=Price, color=Asset)) +
  geom_line(size=0.8) +
  labs(title="Cumulative Price Growth (Normalized to 100)",
       x="Date", y="Price Index") +
  theme_minimal()

# Monthly returns
returns_df <- data.frame(date=index(returns), coredata(returns))
returns_long <- melt(returns_df, id.vars="date", variable.name="Asset", value.name="Return")

ggplot(returns_long, aes(x=date, y=Return, color=Asset)) +
  geom_line(size=0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~Asset, scales="free_y") +
  labs(title="Monthly Returns by Asset Class (2006-2024)",
       x="Date", y="Return") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position="none")
```
```{r}
# Step 5: GARCH

# GARCH spec
spec <- ugarchspec(
  variance.model = list(model = "sGARCH", garchOrder = c(1,1)),
  mean.model = list(armaOrder = c(0,0), include.mean = TRUE),
  distribution.model = "sstd"  # skewed student-t
)

# Fit GARCH per test year using expanding window
garch_fits_list <- list()

for (XX in 2017:2024) {
  end_date <- as.Date(paste0(XX-1, "-12-31"))
  ret_train <- returns[index(returns) <= end_date]
  
  fit_eq <- ugarchfit(spec, ret_train$EQ)
  fit_fi <- ugarchfit(spec, ret_train$FI)
  fit_re <- ugarchfit(spec, ret_train$RE)
  fit_pe <- ugarchfit(spec, ret_train$PE)
  
  garch_fits_list[[as.character(XX)]] <- list(
    EQ = fit_eq, FI = fit_fi, RE = fit_re, PE = fit_pe
  )
  
  cat("XX =", XX, " | GARCH fitted on", nrow(ret_train), "obs\n")
}
```


```{r}
# Step 6: GARCH Diagnostics

param_df <- data.frame(
  year = 2017:2024,
  alpha_EQ = sapply(garch_fits_list, function(f) coef(f$EQ)["alpha1"]),
  beta_EQ = sapply(garch_fits_list, function(f) coef(f$EQ)["beta1"])
)

ggplot(param_df, aes(x=year)) +
  geom_line(aes(y=alpha_EQ, color="alpha")) +
  geom_line(aes(y=beta_EQ, color="beta")) +
  labs(title="EQ GARCH Parameters Across Expanding Windows",
       y="Estimate", x="Test Year") +
  theme_minimal()
# For latest test year fits
fits_2024 <- garch_fits_list[["2024"]]

# Ljung-Box on standardized residuals — should be insignificant
for (asset in c("EQ", "FI", "RE", "PE")) {
  res <- residuals(fits_2024[[asset]], standardize=TRUE)
  lb <- Box.test(res, lag=10, type="Ljung-Box")
  lb_sq <- Box.test(res^2, lag=10, type="Ljung-Box")
  cat(asset, "| LB residuals p:", round(lb$p.value, 3), 
      "| LB squared p:", round(lb_sq$p.value, 3), "\n")
}
persistence_df <- data.frame(
  year = 2017:2024,
  EQ = sapply(garch_fits_list, function(f) sum(coef(f$EQ)[c("alpha1","beta1")])),
  FI = sapply(garch_fits_list, function(f) sum(coef(f$FI)[c("alpha1","beta1")])),
  RE = sapply(garch_fits_list, function(f) sum(coef(f$RE)[c("alpha1","beta1")])),
  PE = sapply(garch_fits_list, function(f) sum(coef(f$PE)[c("alpha1","beta1")]))
)
print(persistence_df)

fits_2024 <- garch_fits_list[["2024"]]


end_date <- as.Date("2023-12-31")
ret_2024 <- returns[index(returns) <= end_date]

vol_df <- data.frame(
  date = index(ret_2024),
  EQ = as.numeric(sigma(fits_2024$EQ)),
  FI = as.numeric(sigma(fits_2024$FI)),
  RE = as.numeric(sigma(fits_2024$RE)),
  PE = as.numeric(sigma(fits_2024$PE))
)

vol_long <- melt(vol_df, id.vars="date", variable.name="Asset", value.name="Volatility")

ggplot(vol_long, aes(x=date, y=Volatility, color=Asset)) +
  geom_line(size=0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~Asset, scales="free_y") +
  labs(title="GARCH(1,1) Conditional Volatility (2006-2023)",
       x="Date", y="Sigma") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position="none")

res <- as.numeric(residuals(fits_2024$EQ, standardize=TRUE))
shape <- coef(fits_2024$EQ)["shape"]

# Sort residuals and compute theoretical quantiles
n <- length(res)
theoretical <- qt(ppoints(n), df=shape)
sample_sorted <- sort(res)

plot(theoretical, sample_sorted,
     main="QQ Plot: EQ standardized residuals vs t-distribution",
     xlab="Theoretical t quantiles", ylab="Sample quantiles",
     pch=20)
abline(0, 1, col="red", lwd=2)
```

```{r}
# Step 7: Copula

copula_fits_list <- list()

for (XX in 2017:2024) {
  fits <- garch_fits_list[[as.character(XX)]]
  
  resid_eq <- as.numeric(residuals(fits$EQ, standardize=TRUE))
  resid_fi <- as.numeric(residuals(fits$FI, standardize=TRUE))
  resid_re <- as.numeric(residuals(fits$RE, standardize=TRUE))
  resid_pe <- as.numeric(residuals(fits$PE, standardize=TRUE))
  
  resid_matrix <- cbind(resid_eq, resid_fi, resid_re, resid_pe)
  u_matrix <- pobs(as.matrix(resid_matrix))
  
  t_cop <- tCopula(dim=4, dispstr="un")
  fit_cop <- fitCopula(t_cop, u_matrix, method="ml")
  
  copula_fits_list[[as.character(XX)]] <- fit_cop
  
cat("XX =", XX,
    "| EQ-FI:", round(fit_cop@estimate[1], 3),
    "| EQ-RE:", round(fit_cop@estimate[2], 3),
    "| EQ-PE:", round(fit_cop@estimate[3], 3),
    "| FI-RE:", round(fit_cop@estimate[4], 3),
    "| FI-PE:", round(fit_cop@estimate[5], 3),
    "| RE-PE:", round(fit_cop@estimate[6], 3),
    "| df:", round(fit_cop@estimate[7], 2), "\n")
}

plot_copula_evolution_gg <- function(pair_name, idx1, idx2) {
  all_data <- data.frame()
  
  for (XX in 2017:2024) {
    fits <- garch_fits_list[[as.character(XX)]]
    
    r1 <- as.numeric(residuals(fits[[idx1]], standardize=TRUE))
    r2 <- as.numeric(residuals(fits[[idx2]], standardize=TRUE))
    
    u1 <- rank(r1) / (length(r1) + 1)
    u2 <- rank(r2) / (length(r2) + 1)
    
    all_data <- rbind(all_data, data.frame(u1=u1, u2=u2, year=XX))
  }
  
  ggplot(all_data, aes(x=u1, y=u2)) +
    stat_density_2d(aes(fill=after_stat(density)), 
                    geom="raster", contour=FALSE) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colors=c("white","blue","red")) +
    facet_wrap(~year, nrow=1) +
    labs(title=paste(pair_name, "Copula Density 2017-2024"),
         x="", y="") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position="none",
          axis.text=element_blank(),
          axis.ticks=element_blank())
}

plot_copula_evolution_gg("EQ-FI", "EQ", "FI")
plot_copula_evolution_gg("EQ-RE", "EQ", "RE")
plot_copula_evolution_gg("EQ-PE", "EQ", "PE")
plot_copula_evolution_gg("FI-RE", "FI", "RE")
plot_copula_evolution_gg("FI-PE", "FI", "PE")
plot_copula_evolution_gg("RE-PE", "RE", "PE")
```

```{r}
# Step 8: Volatility Clustering Simulation
set.seed(3)
N <- 10000
alpha_VaR <- 0.05
D_IEF <- 7.5
D_liab <- 13

# Get year-specific discount rate assumption from PPD
rate_annual <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(fy) %>%
  summarise(y0 = mean(InvestmentReturnAssumption_GASB, na.rm=TRUE))
end_date_full <- as.Date("2016-12-31")
ret_full <- returns[index(returns) <= end_date_full]
ief_annual <- apply.yearly(ret_full$FI, sum)
fi_bounds <- range(as.numeric(ief_annual))
cat("FI bounds:", fi_bounds, "\n")
results_list <- list()

for (XX in 2017:2024) {
  # Get inputs for this year
  # Net flow as % of starting assets
  FR_prev <- agg_df %>% filter(fy == (XX-1)) %>% pull(FR)
  L_prev <- liab_annual %>% filter(fy == (XX-1)) %>% pull(L_total)
  A0 <- FR_prev * L_prev
  L0 <- liab_annual %>% filter(fy == XX) %>% pull(L_total)
  nf <- netflow_annual %>% filter(fy == XX) %>% pull(net_flow)
  
  w <- weights_annual %>% filter(fy == XX) %>%
    dplyr::select(w_eq, w_fi, w_re, w_pe) %>% as.numeric()
  w <- w / sum(w)  # normalize to sum to 1
  
  # Get GARCH fits and copula for this year
  fits <- garch_fits_list[[as.character(XX)]]
  cop_fit <- copula_fits_list[[as.character(XX)]]
  
  # Extract GARCH parameters and last conditional variance
  get_garch_params <- function(fit) {
    list(
    mu = coef(fit)["mu"],
    omega = coef(fit)["omega"],
    alpha = coef(fit)["alpha1"],
    beta = coef(fit)["beta1"],
    shape = coef(fit)["shape"],
    last_sigma2 = tail(sigma(fit), 1)^2,
    last_resid = tail(residuals(fit, standardize=FALSE), 1)  # add this
   )
  }
  
  
  p_eq <- get_garch_params(fits$EQ)
  p_fi <- get_garch_params(fits$FI)
  p_re <- get_garch_params(fits$RE)
  p_pe <- get_garch_params(fits$PE)
  
  # Extract t-copula parameters
  cop_params <- cop_fit@estimate
  rho_mat <- matrix(c(
    1,           cop_params[1], cop_params[2], cop_params[3],
    cop_params[1], 1,           cop_params[4], cop_params[5],
    cop_params[2], cop_params[4], 1,           cop_params[6],
    cop_params[3], cop_params[5], cop_params[6], 1
  ), nrow=4)
  df_cop <- cop_params[7]
  
  # Simulate N paths of 12 monthly returns
  portfolio_returns <- numeric(N)
  fi_annual_returns <- numeric(N)
  
  for (i in 1:N) {
    # Simulate 12 months of correlated uniform innovations from t-copula
    u_sim <- rCopula(12, tCopula(param=cop_params[1:6], dim=4, 
                                  dispstr="un", df=df_cop))
    
    # Convert to t-distributed innovations
    z <- qt(u_sim, df=df_cop)
    z <- pmax(pmin(z, 5), -5)
    
    # Simulate GARCH returns for each asset
    sim_garch <- function(p, z_vec) {
    r <- numeric(12)
    sigma2 <- p$last_sigma2
    last_r <- as.numeric(p$last_resid)  # actual last in-sample return
    for (t in 1:12) {
      prev_r <- if (t == 1) last_r else r[t-1]
      sigma2 <- p$omega + p$alpha * (prev_r - p$mu)^2 + p$beta * sigma2
      sigma2 <- min(sigma2, 1)
      r[t] <- p$mu + sqrt(sigma2) * z_vec[t]
    }
    r
  }
    
    r_eq <- sim_garch(p_eq, z[,1])
    r_fi <- sim_garch(p_fi, z[,2])
    r_re <- sim_garch(p_re, z[,3])
    r_pe <- sim_garch(p_pe, z[,4])
    
    # Annual log returns — sum monthly
    lr_eq <- sum(r_eq)
    lr_fi <- sum(r_fi)
    lr_re <- sum(r_re)
    lr_pe <- sum(r_pe)
    
    # Convert to simple returns
    sr <- exp(c(lr_eq, lr_fi, lr_re, lr_pe)) - 1
    
    # Portfolio return using normalized weights
    portfolio_returns[i] <- sum(w * sr)
    fi_annual_returns[i] <- sr[2]  # FI return for rate adjustment
  }
  
  # Convert to asset values and add net flows
  portfolio_returns <- pmax(pmin(portfolio_returns, 10), -1)
  A_paths <- A0 * (1 + portfolio_returns) + nf
  
  # Winsorize FI returns at historical bounds before rate adjustment
  fi_bounds <- range(as.numeric(ief_annual))
  fi_annual_returns_capped <- pmax(pmin(fi_annual_returns, fi_bounds[2]), fi_bounds[1])
  
  # Revalue liabilities using implied rate change from FI return
  y0 <- rate_annual %>% filter(fy == XX) %>% pull(y0)  # base discount rate 
  delta_y <- -fi_annual_returns_capped / D_IEF
  L_paths <- L0 * ((1 + y0) / (1 + y0 + delta_y))^D_liab
  
  # Funded ratio per path
  FR_paths <- A_paths / L_paths
  
  # VaR and CVaR at 5%
  VaR_95 <- quantile(FR_paths, alpha_VaR)
  CVaR_95 <- mean(FR_paths[FR_paths <= VaR_95])
  
  # Actual reported funded ratio
  FR_actual <- agg_df %>% filter(fy == XX) %>% pull(FR)
  
  results_list[[as.character(XX)]] <- data.frame(
    year = XX,
    VaR_95 = VaR_95,
    CVaR_95 = CVaR_95,
    FR_mean = mean(FR_paths),
    FR_actual = FR_actual
  )

}
```


```{r}
# Step 9: Constant Variance Simulation
set.seed(3)
results_const_list <- list()

for (XX in 2017:2024) {
  FR_prev <- agg_df %>% filter(fy == (XX-1)) %>% pull(FR)
  L_prev <- liab_annual %>% filter(fy == (XX-1)) %>% pull(L_total)
  A0 <- FR_prev * L_prev
  L0 <- liab_annual %>% filter(fy == XX) %>% pull(L_total)
  nf <- netflow_annual %>% filter(fy == XX) %>% pull(net_flow)

  w <- weights_annual %>% filter(fy == XX) %>%
    dplyr::select(w_eq, w_fi, w_re, w_pe) %>% as.numeric()
  w <- w / sum(w)

  end_date <- as.Date(paste0(XX-1, "-12-31"))
  ret_train <- returns[index(returns) <= end_date]
  mu_const <- colMeans(ret_train)
  sd_const <- apply(ret_train, 2, sd)

  portfolio_returns <- numeric(N)
  fi_annual_returns <- numeric(N)

  for (i in 1:N) {
    r_mat <- matrix(rnorm(12 * 4), nrow=12)
    r_mat <- sweep(r_mat, 2, sd_const, "*")
    r_mat <- sweep(r_mat, 2, mu_const, "+")
    sr <- exp(colSums(r_mat)) - 1
    portfolio_returns[i] <- sum(w * sr)
    fi_annual_returns[i] <- sr[2]
  }

  portfolio_returns <- pmax(pmin(portfolio_returns, 10), -1)
  fi_annual_returns_capped <- pmax(pmin(fi_annual_returns, fi_bounds[2]), fi_bounds[1])

  A_paths <- A0 * (1 + portfolio_returns) + nf
  y0 <- rate_annual %>% filter(fy == XX) %>% pull(y0)
  delta_y <- -fi_annual_returns_capped / D_IEF
  L_paths <- L0 * ((1 + y0) / (1 + y0 + delta_y))^D_liab
  FR_paths <- A_paths / L_paths

  VaR_95 <- quantile(FR_paths, alpha_VaR)
  CVaR_95 <- mean(FR_paths[FR_paths <= VaR_95])
  FR_actual <- agg_df %>% filter(fy == XX) %>% pull(FR)

  results_const_list[[as.character(XX)]] <- data.frame(
    year = XX,
    VaR_95_const = VaR_95,
    CVaR_95_const = CVaR_95,
    FR_mean_const = mean(FR_paths),
    FR_actual = FR_actual
  )

  cat("XX =", XX,
      "| VaR(const):", round(VaR_95, 4),
      "| CVaR(const):", round(CVaR_95, 4), "\n")
}


```


```{r}
# Step 10: Var/cVaR Comparison
results_df <- do.call(rbind, results_list)
results_const_df <- do.call(rbind, results_const_list)

# Combine results
comparison_df <- merge(
  results_df[, c("year", "VaR_95", "CVaR_95")],
  results_const_df[, c("year", "VaR_95_const", "CVaR_95_const")],
  by = "year"
)

print(comparison_df)

# Plot
ggplot(comparison_df, aes(x=year)) +
  geom_line(aes(y=VaR_95, color="GARCH-Copula", linetype="VaR(5%)"), size=1) +
  geom_line(aes(y=CVaR_95, color="GARCH-Copula", linetype="CVaR(5%)"), size=1) +
  geom_line(aes(y=VaR_95_const, color="Constant Variance", linetype="VaR(5%)"), size=1) +
  geom_line(aes(y=CVaR_95_const, color="Constant Variance", linetype="CVaR(5%)"), size=1) +
  geom_point(aes(y=VaR_95, color="GARCH-Copula"), size=2) +
  geom_point(aes(y=CVaR_95, color="GARCH-Copula"), size=2) +
  geom_point(aes(y=VaR_95_const, color="Constant Variance"), size=2) +
  geom_point(aes(y=CVaR_95_const, color="Constant Variance"), size=2) +
  labs(title="VaR and CVaR: GARCH-Copula vs Constant Variance",
       x="Year", y="Funded Ratio VaR/CVaR",
       color="Model", linetype="Measure") +
  theme_minimal()

comparison_df$VaR_gap <- comparison_df$VaR_95_const - comparison_df$VaR_95
comparison_df$CVaR_gap <- comparison_df$CVaR_95_const - comparison_df$CVaR_95
cat("Mean VaR gap:", round(mean(comparison_df$VaR_gap), 4), "\n")
cat("Mean CVaR gap:", round(mean(comparison_df$CVaR_gap), 4), "\n")
cat("Max VaR gap:", round(max(comparison_df$VaR_gap), 4), "\n")
cat("Max CVaR gap:", round(max(comparison_df$CVaR_gap), 4), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Step 11: 2021 Market Crash Predictions
# FR distribution comparison for 2021
set.seed(3)
XX <- 2021

# GARCH-Copula paths
FR_prev <- agg_df %>% filter(fy == (XX-1)) %>% pull(FR)
L_prev <- liab_annual %>% filter(fy == (XX-1)) %>% pull(L_total)
A0 <- FR_prev * L_prev
L0 <- liab_annual %>% filter(fy == XX) %>% pull(L_total)
nf <- netflow_annual %>% filter(fy == XX) %>% pull(net_flow)

w <- weights_annual %>% filter(fy == XX) %>%
  dplyr::select(w_eq, w_fi, w_re, w_pe) %>% as.numeric()
w <- w / sum(w)

fits <- garch_fits_list[[as.character(XX)]]
cop_fit <- copula_fits_list[[as.character(XX)]]
cop_params <- cop_fit@estimate
df_cop <- cop_params[7]

p_eq <- get_garch_params(fits$EQ)
p_fi <- get_garch_params(fits$FI)
p_re <- get_garch_params(fits$RE)
p_pe <- get_garch_params(fits$PE)

portfolio_returns_garch <- numeric(N)
fi_returns_garch <- numeric(N)

for (i in 1:N) {
  u_sim <- rCopula(12, tCopula(param=cop_params[1:6], dim=4, dispstr="un", df=df_cop))
  z <- qt(u_sim, df=df_cop)
  z <- pmax(pmin(z, 5), -5)
  r_eq <- sim_garch(p_eq, z[,1])
  r_fi <- sim_garch(p_fi, z[,2])
  r_re <- sim_garch(p_re, z[,3])
  r_pe <- sim_garch(p_pe, z[,4])
  sr <- exp(c(sum(r_eq), sum(r_fi), sum(r_re), sum(r_pe))) - 1
  portfolio_returns_garch[i] <- sum(w * sr)
  fi_returns_garch[i] <- sr[2]
}

portfolio_returns_garch <- pmax(pmin(portfolio_returns_garch, 10), -1)
fi_returns_garch_capped <- pmax(pmin(fi_returns_garch, fi_bounds[2]), fi_bounds[1])
y0 <- rate_annual %>% filter(fy == XX) %>% pull(y0)
delta_y <- -fi_returns_garch_capped / D_IEF
L_paths_garch <- L0 * ((1 + y0) / (1 + y0 + delta_y))^D_liab
A_paths_garch <- A0 * (1 + portfolio_returns_garch) + nf
FR_garch <- A_paths_garch / L_paths_garch

# Constant variance paths
end_date <- as.Date(paste0(XX-1, "-12-31"))
ret_train <- returns[index(returns) <= end_date]
mu_const <- colMeans(ret_train)
sd_const <- apply(ret_train, 2, sd)

portfolio_returns_const <- numeric(N)
fi_returns_const <- numeric(N)

for (i in 1:N) {
  r_mat <- matrix(rnorm(12 * 4), nrow=12)
  r_mat <- sweep(r_mat, 2, sd_const, "*")
  r_mat <- sweep(r_mat, 2, mu_const, "+")
  sr <- exp(colSums(r_mat)) - 1
  portfolio_returns_const[i] <- sum(w * sr)
  fi_returns_const[i] <- sr[2]
}

portfolio_returns_const <- pmax(pmin(portfolio_returns_const, 10), -1)
fi_returns_const_capped <- pmax(pmin(fi_returns_const, fi_bounds[2]), fi_bounds[1])
delta_y_const <- -fi_returns_const_capped / D_IEF
L_paths_const <- L0 * ((1 + y0) / (1 + y0 + delta_y_const))^D_liab
A_paths_const <- A0 * (1 + portfolio_returns_const) + nf
FR_const <- A_paths_const / L_paths_const

# Combine and plot
dist_df <- data.frame(
  FR = c(FR_garch, FR_const),
  Model = rep(c("GARCH-Copula", "Constant Variance"), each=N)
)

VaR_g <- quantile(FR_garch, 0.05)
VaR_c <- quantile(FR_const, 0.05)
CVaR_g <- mean(FR_garch[FR_garch <= VaR_g])
CVaR_c <- mean(FR_const[FR_const <= VaR_c])

dist_df_trimmed <- dist_df %>% filter(FR >= 0.0 & FR <= quantile(dist_df$FR, 0.995))


ggplot(dist_df_trimmed, aes(x=FR, fill=Model, color=Model)) +
  geom_density(alpha=0.3, size=0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=VaR_g, color="#00BFC4", linetype="dashed", size=1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=VaR_c, color="#F8766D", linetype="dashed", size=1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=CVaR_g, color="#00BFC4", linetype="solid", size=1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=CVaR_c, color="#F8766D", linetype="solid", size=1) +
  labs(title="Funded Ratio Distribution: 2021",
       subtitle="Dashed = VaR(5%), Solid = CVaR(5%)",
       x="Funded Ratio", y="Density") +
  theme_minimal()
```
